worldcombat.skill.ragingbull.summary: Lower the horns and charge in a straight line: plow through everything on the way and shatter the Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil along the path. Its type follows the user's form among Normal, Fighting, Fire and Water. The only member of the family that moves with its attack.
worldcombat.skill.ragingbull.use.0: Charge through a line of enemies
worldcombat.skill.ragingbull.use.2: A heavy opener whose type follows the form
worldcombat.skill.ragingbull.description: The charge deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block body radius; its type follows the user's form among Normal, Fighting, Fire and Water, and the target's Defence, type matchup and criticals settle on impact.

Charge up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick, stopping early against impassable blocks; a hit shoves the target about %3$s blocks and shatters Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil within %4$s blocks of the hit point.
worldcombat.skill.ragingbull.trample.on: Trample mode: plow through up to four targets, shoving further and shattering wider, at 0.9x per hit and +8 ticks of cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.ragingbull.trample.off: Stop mode: hit only the first target at 1.1x power, shoving less and recovering faster; anyone else on the path is unaffected.
worldcombat.skill.ragingbull.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.ragingbull.growth.0: From level %1$s the ram rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.ragingbull.growth.1: From level %1$s the ram rises to %2$s and the charge distance to %3$s.
On: plow through up to four targets, shoving further and shattering wider, at 0.9x per hit and +8 ticks of cooldown. Off: stop at the first target at 1.1x power.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of charging. Larger values open the charge from further out.
On: prefer a target with other enemies packed nearby, so the path hits more of them. Off: rank by threat and distance only.
world_combat.move.ragingbull.text.miss: Raging Bull charged through empty air
